text:
anya: Quick sync — we have a customer-driven onramp ask (FinLens) that bumps the timeline if we don't relax the initial SLA. Need cross-team sequencing call. TL;DR: they need private deployment + dedicated capacity by end of next quarter. Can we scope a launch that keeps runtime changes minimal?

sam: Thanks. Do we have exact latency / qps targets from the customer?

anya: They asked for p95 < 300ms for single-turn generation at 512 tokens, and steady 120 qps for peak. They're ok with a canary at lower qps for week 1.

miguel: 120 qps steady + p95 300ms at 512 is doable but needs more reserved GPUs in Dedicated or a high-priority pool. Current Dedicated plans only cover ~60 qps at that profile.

zack: From eng side — the private deployment image needs a tiny config tweak (KMS and mTLS). No model changes. We can ship the tweak in 2 sprints if infra gives capacity.

jess: Security: for private we need HSM or KMS integration + audit logs (retention 1y). That will add ~5 days for cert rotations and IAM rules. Also need an SSO mapping for their org.

anya: So blockers: capacity (infra), KMS/HSM + audit pipeline (security), runtime perf validation/canary (runtime/eng). Proposal: 1) carve a 4-GPU canary pool in week A, 2) run a 1-week load canary at 30 qps, validate perf and cost, 3) expand to reserved capacity for launch. Thoughts?

sam: Runtime note: to hit p95 300ms we should ship a KV-cache warmup script and enable dynamic batching at small batch sizes for low latency. That might be a config-only change: 
```
# enable dynamic batching
dynamic_batching: true
batch_max_tokens: 4096
prefill_warmup: true
```
We can prepare the image in 3 business days for canary.

miguel: If we do that, infra needs lead time to allocate a private pool. For on-prem we need network ACLs and a VPC peer set up with the customer's subnet. For cloud private we can do it faster but need committed billing. Timeline estimate: 5 business days for cloud private, 10 for on-prem (network approvals included).

jess: Also: provide the customer an SSP (security scoping plan) and the list of audit events we capture. I can draft the minimal set today.

anya: Okay — tradeoffs: if we reduce initial qps requirement (they said canary is fine), we can launch earlier. If not, we push launch by ~3 weeks to accommodate infra and HSM.

sam: Action items for runtime: (1) prepare canary image with dynamic batching & KV warmup (ETA 3d), (2) perf harness for 512-token p95 tests (ETA 2d), (3) smoke script for end-to-end private deployment (ETA 1d).

miguel: Action items infra: (1) provision 4-GPU pool (cloud private) ETA 5d after approval, (2) set up VPC peering + routing rules (ETA 2d parallel), (3) billing commit approval from sales (depends).

jess: Sec action: (1) SSP draft + required audit events (E2) by EOD, (2) KMS/HSM integration checklist + cert rotation plan in 3d, (3) SSO mapping template in 2d.

zack: Eng: coordinate runtime image rollout, feature flag for canary, and gating tests in CI. I can own the feature flag and CI gates. ETA 4d.

anya: Great. Who can drive the infra approval with Sales for commit? @miguel can you ping sales?

miguel: Will do. Pinged @sales-lead in thread (DM sent).

anya: Let's aim for a product/infra/security 15-min triage tomorrow at 10am to confirm approvals and freeze the canary window. If anyone can't make it, reply with constraints.

sam: 10am works. I'll bring perf numbers and a short test plan.

jess: Works for me. Will bring SSP draft.

zack: I'm out 10–10:30 but can join after 10:30 if needed.

miguel: I can be there.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: no active deploys scheduled for tomorrow 10:00–11:00 (window free). :white_check_mark:

anya: Cool — I'll send a calendar invite and own the launch checklist. Final ask: can we agree to a minimum viable canary acceptance criteria? I propose: 1) p95 <= 350ms at 30 qps for 24h, 2) error rate < 0.5%, 3) audit logs present for every request. If we hit these, we scale.

sam: Fine with 350ms threshold for canary. We will aim for 300ms but allow 350 as pass.

jess: Audit logs: agreed. I will validate log entries during canary.

miguel: Once sales signs the commit, infra will allocate. Otherwise we can't guarantee capacity.

anya: Thanks all — invite sent. Will post the checklist and link to the perf harness repo in the channel after the meeting. :rocket:
